CategoryId.description: Unique identifier of the adjustment category.

ParentCategoryId.description: Unique identifier of the parent category that serves as a base price for the current category.

AbsoluteValue.description: Absolute value of the adjustment (e.g. `50` represents 50 EUR in case the rate currency is `EUR`).

RelativeValue.description: Relative value of the adjustment (e.g. `0.5` represents 50% increase).
